title: Checks from annotations
description:
Validate objects with your own annotations read by reflection.

```
User[name=, age=12]
  name: must not be blank
  age: must be at least 13
User[name=Ada, age=36]: valid
```
hints: `Min min = field.getAnnotation(Min.class); if (min != null && field.getInt(o) < min.value()) ...` (lesson 7.03). `field.get(o)` reads a field of any type as an `Object`, for example the `String` that `@NotBlank` checks.
`@interface Min { int value(); }` lets you write `@Min(13)`.
requirements: `List<String> validate(Object o)` loops over `getDeclaredFields()`, reads the annotations and checks the values.
stretch: Add `@MaxLength(int value)` and a `message` element with a default for each annotation.
